checkpoint: F3.2 Usage in Overview and per function output in Logs
how_rendered: The real components rendered by a throwaway Vite page with a stub request (the usage and output answers the server gives), captured with headless Google Chrome at exact viewports (desktop 1360 wide, phone 390 wide, device scale 1). The server routes are tested against the real handler (tests/functions-worker.test.ts) and the event worker against the hardened container (docs/evidence/functions-f3-event-check-2026-10-30). Not a live installation.
